name: hermes-agent-runtime
description: Provenance pin for the on-host Hermes agent/gateway runtime that OpenBurnBar vendors as compiled bytecode (gateway/, plugins/, tools/, hermes_cli/, tui_gateway/, agent/). Security remediation C-5: makes the most security-sensitive host-side component auditable + verifiable instead of opaque .pyc.
hashDefinition: sha256 over the LC_ALL=C-sorted list of 'path sha256(blob)\n' lines for every *.py file under vendoredSubtrees at pinnedCommit (see scripts/ci/verify-vendored-agent-source.sh; locale pinned 2026-06-11 after macOS/CI sort divergence).

pendingHardening.reason: CLEARED 2026-06-11: C-4 (agent command-guard hardening: secret-read/exfil gating, fail-closed tirith, smart-mode escalation) is commit bdb830070, pushed to the public fork branch ajnunezg/burnbar-gateway-e2ee and now the pinnedCommit above. The 2026-06-11 diligence review found the previous clearance (e0ba632f5) pinned a commit that existed on no remote; this clearance is verifiable: gh api repos/Ajnunezg/hermes-agent/commits/bdb830070 resolves, and the PR harness cross-checks its checkout ref against this manifest so the gate always executes the commit the manifest attests.

auditNote: The shipping product vendors this runtime as .pyc while the reviewed .py source is pinned here. Release and security CI verify the pinned fork checkout with scripts/ci/verify-vendored-agent-source.sh and require scripts/create-corresponding-source.sh to bundle the pinned source tree under third_party/hermes-agent/source/ in the AGPL corresponding-source archive.
